requirements.text: When a registered user requests access to the dashboard, the dashboard access shall be granted.
When a registered user requests access to the dashboard, the dashboard access shall not be granted.
When a customer submits an order, an order confirmation email shall be sent.
When a customer submits an order, an order confirmation email shall not be sent.
When the login attempt count is greater than 10 and the login attempt count is less than 3, the system shall lock the account.
When a customer updates their profile, the profile update shall be recorded.
When the application starts successfully, the startup event shall be recorded.
